title: EDG Community Update: July 18th, 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- [Website v3](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1549029277894836225) is now live!
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.4](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/erup-5) to be prepared for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade’s on-chain democracy proposal.
- The Twitter Meme Competition aka campaign 2 from The Cutting Edge Conquest series concluded at 6 pm UTC on 20th July and [winners have been announced](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1550179090816462848). 
- Upcoming Activities: The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns, Kabocha’s Technical AMA ft. Ramsey and Rusty Crewmates, Kabocha’s Community Mods Onboarding Quiz


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Decent Partners shared [a legal assessment of ‘Exchange B’](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1549076797689561091).
- Zien announced [collaborations with 3 era-defining contemporary artists](https://twitter.com/joinzien/status/1550151515255570433).
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-july-17/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcomed to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- Referend
